# ANALYSIS: STAGE1_BACKTEST_J_ANCHORS_OOS_SHARPE

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** backtest_validation
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are running a Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder to validate that the current engine configuration (or a specific candidate under test) meets the OP-16 anchor no-regression (edge_capture ≥ 0 on J days) and achieves an OOS Sharpe ≥ 0.70, with real-fills validation on the top 3 J days.

## Mechanism

The autoresearch grinder will run a backtest over the available historical data, compute the edge_capture on the J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04 as winners; 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 as losers) and ensure that the edge_capture is non-negative (i.e., no regression on anchor days). It will also compute the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio and require it to be at least 0.70. Additionally, it will validate the real-fills on the top 3 J days (the three winner days: 4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by comparing the backtest results with realistic simulator (real OPRA fills) and ensuring the difference is within ±20%.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The backtest is run assuming a $25K+ account size for qty=28 (as per OP-20 disclosure 1). For paper trading, $1K accounts realize ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** The sample size is the entire available historical data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for the autoresearch grinder. Selection method is the full period. Overfit risk is mitigated by the OOS Sharpe requirement and walk-forward validation (if included in the grinder).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (the backtest will compute OOS Sharpe; we require ≥0.70)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (the backtest will validate real-fills on top 3 J days; we require <±20% diff)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: max loss on a single J day; max drawdown: to be determined from backtest; blow-up scenario: if the strategy fails to meet edge_capture ≥0 or OOS Sharpe <0.70.
6. **Concentration:** To be determined from backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X).

## Pre-merge gate

The backtest must pass: edge_capture ≥ 0 on J days, OOS Sharpe ≥ 0.70, and real-fills validation on top 3 J days (diff <±20%).
